body.message:
Hamid, being honest with you, a 2-bedroom within AED 5,000/month isn't something we can offer. Our most affordable 2BR starts at AED 7,000/month, and we do have a studio in Business Bay from AED 4,400/month, fully all-inclusive with nothing extra on top.

If a studio works for your stay, we can move quickly. Is that worth considering?
